pages.text: A Radiant Trove is a storage container that can contain up to 1024 stacks of a single type of item.$(br2)A Radiant Trove's storage capacity can be upgraded three times, using a $(l:items/scepter_manipulation)Scepter of Manipulation$(). The first upgrade increases storage to 3x base capacity, the second to 6x, and the third to 10x.
When used as an upgrade, a $(l:items/containment_field)Containment Field$() causes items added to the Trove in excess of its maximum capacity are destroyed.
pages.title: Containment Field

pages.text: When used as an upgrade, a $(l:items/radiant_key)Radiant Key$() locks the type of item in the trove. Once the trove reaches 0 stored items, it will still reserve its storage for the type of item it once held.
pages.title: Radiant Key

pages.text: Using a $(l:items/scepter_revelation)Scepter of Revelation$() on a Radiant Trove will return what type of item is stored, its current and maximum capacity, and how many upgrades have been installed.
pages.title: Scepter of Revelation

pages.text: Using a $(l:items/scepter_manipulation)Scepter of Manipulation$() on a Radiant Trove opens a GUI that allows you to see and modify what upgrades are installed.
pages.title: Scepter of Manipulation

pages.text: When monitored with a Redstone Comparator, a Radiant Trove outputs a signal based on how full it is.
pages.title: Redstone Comparator
